events.label: Quarter-end / Q2 2026 close — NVDA forced exit at open; regime gate-clearing candidate
events.note: Q2 2026 close. June 29 delivered Nasdaq +2.07% (SCOTUS upheld Fed independence, Alphabet joined Dow +5%, Dow above 52,000 first time). SPX closed 7,436 — 24 pts below 7,460 gate. NVDA Stop Day 2 TRIGGERED ($194.97, $0.03 below $195) — mandatory full exit selling at open is the primary headwind. Window dressing bid (large-cap tech: GOOGL, META, MSFT, AMZN) is the gate-clearing mechanism. Gate condition: SPX close > 7,460 AND VIX close < 17 simultaneously = HOLD upgrade confirmed. Close below 7,300 activates BEARISH escalation framework. If both gates clear on June 30, BUY consideration for July 1 ISM morning.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing Index (10:00 AM ET) — first Q3 economic read
events.note: June ISM Manufacturing official release — first Q3 data point. May 2026 ISM was 54.0 (beat); June flash PMI was 55.7 (49-month high per S&P Global). SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — Q3 opens with institutional certainty about the monetary governance framework. ISM above 55: Goldilocks manufacturing + AI demand = constructive for semis/tech heading into Q2 earnings season. ISM below 50: first recessionary data point since the BofA rate-hike repricing — forces regime re-evaluation and likely breaks SPX through 7,300. Key early-Q3 positioning catalyst.

events.label: June Non-Farm Payrolls 8:30 AM ET — consensus 114K–130K (PULLED FORWARD; markets closed July 3)
events.note: June employment report pulled forward from July 3 to Thursday July 2 (markets closed July 3, Independence Day observed). Consensus RANGE: 114K (FXStreet) to 130K (Capital Economics) — below the soft-landing corridor floor from the prior May print of +172K. THREE SCENARIOS: (1) STRONG (+150K+, wages +0.4%) = BofA three-hike framework (Sep/Oct/Dec 2026) locked in; DXY spikes; 30Y approaches 5.00% trigger; SPX gaps lower July 7 — HOLD degrades to STEP ASIDE/BEARISH. (2) GOLDILOCKS (90–150K, wages +0.2%) = regime confirms; BUY upgrade viable for July 7; GOOGL long expands; NVDA re-entry window opens post-Aug earnings. (3) WEAK (<90K, wages flat) = recession fears emerge; Fed hike narrative collapses; TLT long pays off; but growth tech faces further selling. Markets closed July 3 — NFP reaction prints into a 3-day weekend gap; positions cannot be hedged until July 7 open.

events.label: US Market Holiday — Independence Day observed (July 4 falls on Saturday)
events.note: US equity markets closed Friday July 3 as July 4, 2026 falls on a Saturday. 3-day weekend gap (July 3-6). The June NFP report prints Thursday July 2 — any repricing accumulates over the full 3-day gap before July 7 open. Use July 2 close as the last chance to hedge or reduce before the gap.

events.label: SPCX added to Nasdaq-100 Index — ~$4.3B forced passive inflows from QQQ/QQQM; post-NFP holiday return
events.note: Dual catalyst day: (1) SPCX (SpaceX) inclusion in Nasdaq-100 effective July 7 — QQQ/QQQM forced to buy ~$4.3B of SPCX at index weight. Mechanical passive-flow catalyst. SCOTUS ruling June 29 indirectly positive for SPCX valuation (reduces institutional risk-off). (2) July 7 open reflects the full NFP repricing accumulated over the July 4 3-day gap — if NFP was strong, gap-down; if Goldilocks, potential gap-up into earnings season. Two simultaneous catalysts (NFP repricing + SPCX passive flow) create higher-than-normal volatility. NVDA re-entry window opens IF SPX > 7,460 AND VIX < 17 simultaneously AND NVDA > $200 on volume.

events.label: FOMC Minutes from June 17 meeting (est.) — first post-dot-plot-removal release
events.note: Minutes from the June 17 FOMC meeting (est. release ~3 weeks after meeting). First FOMC at which Warsh removed the dot plot. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — minutes will reveal the internal rate debate with full institutional certainty now restored. Unanimous hawkish tone = BofA 3-hike forecast solidified. Any dissent or hike-pause language = dovish surprise and rate relief. Key input for Q3 positioning heading into the July 14 CPI print.

events.label: SK Hynix ADR Nasdaq listing — $29.4B offering, 17.79M shares (potentially largest ADR in history)
events.note: SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR listing — $29.4B offering (17.79M shares). Underwriters: BofA, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, JPMorgan. June 29 context: KOSPI sold -3.05% (intraday -5.81%) on Samsung Blue House $648B; SK Hynix -1.83% below ₩2,700K long entry threshold. ADR stability depends on KOSPI stabilization above 8,500 and SK Hynix reclaiming ₩2,700K on two consecutive sessions before July 10. Underwriter stabilization mandate (BofA/Goldman/Citigroup/JPMorgan) provides ADR floor support. TSM +3.40% June 29 (Winbond partnership) is a constructive read-through for HBM4 demand confirmation. Full exit review on SK Hynix Q2 KST earnings ~July 29.

events.label: June CPI release (est.) — most important inflation data of the summer
events.note: June CPI is the next major inflation recalibration after May PCE (June 25, 4.1% YoY). US-Iran stand-down confirmed June 29 — Brent at $72-73/bbl, Hormuz normalization intact. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — Warsh's rate path is now politically protected and data-driven. June CPI captures the first full month of Iran peace deal normalization. If CPI falls to 3.5% or below, the BofA 3-hike framework weakens materially and the July 28 FOMC hike probability collapses. If CPI holds at 4.0%+, September hike is locked in. July 14 is the critical regime-reset date for H2 2026 positioning.

events.label: FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — rate hike on the table
events.note: Nine of 18 FOMC officials projected at least one 2026 rate hike at the June 17 meeting (Warsh's first as Chair). BofA calls for three hikes (Sep/Oct/Dec). A 25-bps hike (3.50-3.75% → 3.75-4.00%) at this meeting is a non-trivial probability if June CPI disappoints. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — Warsh can hike without political interference. June CPI (~July 14) is the primary input. Rate hike = BEARISH regime confirmation. AI capex robust ($750B in 2026) but higher rates still compress growth multiples.

events.label: Iran-US Islamabad Declaration 60-day deadline — Hormuz full reopening + sanctions relief
events.note: Deal operational from June 18 MOU signing; 60-day window expires August 13. June 29 US-Iran 'stand down' confirmed — both sides agreed to halt tit-for-tat attacks ahead of technical talks. Brent at $72.91, Hormuz normalization proceeding. If August 13 deadline met with full Hormuz clearance, WTI could extend to $65-67 — extend XLE short and exit TBT. Failure = oil spike reversal and energy re-rally. The oil-crash pace is ahead of schedule relative to the original June 18 MOU framework.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since the June 12 IPO. SPCX confirmed in Russell 1000 and Nasdaq-100 (effective July 7). Capital structure: $75B IPO + $60B xAI acquisition + $20B bond offering = $155B in obligations. First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn rate) is the fundamental clearing event for re-entry. Two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume required before re-entry from current ~$153 range.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs; the $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds equity supply overhang on top. Exact date pending the prospectus's stated terms.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst and adds uncertainty to AI infrastructure spending trajectories. Monitor for filing date announcement as a potential AI sentiment catalyst. Date is approximate placeholder for H1 2027 window.
